# TopologicalFeatureInvariance

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The property that certain landscape features (e.g., saddle points, minima connectivity) remain invariant under random linear maps used for dimensionality reduction. Guides the design of topology-aware compression layers in in-network computing, ensuring that critical routing or learning dynamics are not distorted.
